processes.name: Voucher handling
processes.description: Receiving, scanning, matching, and posting vouchers/receipts. Includes supplier invoices, receipts, and credit notes.
processes.notes: Propell.ai can automate 23-40% (no-touch rate). Largest time sink.

processes.name: Bank reconciliation
processes.description: Matching bank transactions against booked entries in TripleTex. Identifying discrepancies.
processes.notes: Propell.ai provides full coverage. Currently done manually.

processes.name: VAT reporting
processes.description: Calculating VAT, preparing MVA-melding, submitting to Altinn. Bi-monthly cycle.
processes.notes: TripleTex calculates MVA, but submission is manual. Automation opportunity.

processes.name: Payroll
processes.description: Monthly payroll processing for client companies. Includes tax, holiday pay, A-melding.
processes.notes: Sanna could cover this fully. Currently using Excel + manual TripleTex entry.

processes.name: Year-end closing
processes.description: Annual financial statements, tax returns, and regulatory filings for all clients.
processes.notes: Highly complex, client-specific. Key person risk: Ole + Bjørg hold most knowledge.

processes.name: Customer invoicing
processes.description: Generating and sending invoices to Systemregnskap's own customers for accounting services.
processes.notes: TripleTex covers basic invoicing. Opportunity: automated recurring invoices.

processes.name: Payment control
processes.description: Monitoring incoming payments, matching against invoices, following up on overdue payments.
processes.notes: Largely manual. Could be automated with bank integration + rules engine.

processes.name: Customer onboarding
processes.description: Registering new customers, setting up accounts in TripleTex, collecting initial data.
processes.notes: Low volume but manual. Customer portal would eliminate most manual work.

processes.name: Document management
processes.description: Organizing, storing, and retrieving financial documents. Version control of client files.
processes.notes: No structured DMS. Files scattered across file server and email. Knowledge loss risk.

processes.name: Reporting to clients
processes.description: Preparing and delivering periodic financial reports to clients.
processes.notes: Could be automated with TripleTex API + report templates. PowerBI for dashboards.

processes.name: Tax returns
processes.description: Preparing and filing tax returns for client companies and individuals.
processes.notes: Regulatory complexity. Arne (68) holds most knowledge. Critical knowledge loss risk.

processes.name: Credit card/expenses
processes.description: Processing employee expense reports and credit card statements for clients.
processes.notes: Propell.ai provides full coverage. Currently 100% manual.
